digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift workflow and Gerrit CI integration
propositions: Terraform drift workflow does not trigger on Gerrit changes, only on pull_request, push to main, or schedule, allowing un-applied terraform to land and pass CI gates
A terraform change can receive Verified +1 and be submitted without the drift check running, because the check only executes post-merge when the push to main trigger fires
Manual terraform applies are separate from CI/CD and landing process, creating a state where green CI signals do not guarantee infrastructure exists
The drift check must distinguish between not-yet-applied resources in the change under review (expected) and previously-committed unapplied HCL (defect) to avoid false failures on all terraform PRs
Documentation and runbooks do not currently mandate or clarify that terraform changes require a manual apply step before landing is considered complete
